Metadata.Title: Polish bro's MGS series 8
Metadata.Description: Greetings everyone, Polish bro here.Following the operations in New York and Sapienza, ICA has located the last remaining members of Hollow Circle in Whittleton Creek. Hidden among ordinary citizens, they are preparing to abandon their identities and disappear for good.Your objective is to eliminate every target before the organization can be rebuilt.Once this operation is complete, Hollow Circle will finally cease to exist.Good hunting, 47.
